x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"attachment\":{\"upload_id\":\"01JE72344JZKJD6KWEKSVBEKCD\"}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/checklist/lists/%7Blist_id%7D/attachments", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "-----011000010111000001101001\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"attachment\"\r\n\r\nstring\r\n-----011000010111000001101001--\r\n"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "multipart/form-data; boundary=---011000010111000001101001"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/checklist/lists/%7Blist_id%7D/attachments", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

x-changelog.description: The `attachment.upload_id` field (available in `application/json` requests) is the recommended approach for file uploads, providing higher performance and reliability.
